//   ③SolidSide blockType∈{4,5}：pass 内无半砖/坡，不触达。
//   EmptyTile 不在 chest 锚类型 → 非活动腿恒 false。
bool DgChestLegOK(int lx, int ly)
{
    int li = ly * W + lx;
    if (act[li] == 0) return false;
    ushort t = typ[li];
    bool invalid = DG_CHEST_ANCH_INVALID.Contains(t);
    if (SOLID.Contains(t) && !dgSolidTop.Contains(t) && !DG_NO_ATTACH_DG.Contains(t) && !invalid) return true;
    if (DG_PLATFORMS_DG.Contains(t)) return !invalid;
    if (SOLID.Contains(t) && dgSolidTop.Contains(t)) return true;
    if (DG_TILE_TABLE_DG.Contains(t)) return true;
    return false;
}

SHEET[st.type[i]!]! : 0}/${st.wall[i]}`); cnt++; }\n      }\n    }\n    void existsSync;\n  }, 300_000);\n}\n\nif (process.env.SW_DGCAP !== '1' && process.env.SW_DGREP !== '1') {\n  it.skip('env gate', () => {});\n}\n"

			new DungeonWindowBasic(dungeonWindowBasicSettings).GenerateFeature(data, i + 8, num7 - 16);
			dungeonWindowBasicSettings.Width = 7;
			dungeonWindowBasicSettings.Height = 11;
			new DungeonWindowBasic(dungeonWindowBasicSettings).GenerateFeature(data, i - 10, num7 - 37);
			new DungeonWindowBasic(dungeonWindowBasicSettings).GenerateFeature(data, i + 10, num7 - 37);
			dungeonWindowBasicSettings.Height = 13;
			new DungeonWindowBasic(dungeonWindowBasicSettings).GenerateFeature(data, i, num7 - 39);
		}
		if (generating)
		{
			TowerEntrance_Door(data, i, num7, num4, num3, flag, dungeonEntranceIsBuried);
			TowerEntrance_Door(data, i, num7, num4, num3, !flag, dungeonEntranceIsBuried);
		}
		OldManSpawn = DungeonUtils.SetOldManSpawnAndSpawnOldManIfDefaultDungeon(i, num7, generating);
		if (generating && SpecialSeedFeatures.DungeonEntranceHasATree)
		{
			DungeonUtils.GenerateDungeonTree(data, i, (int)Main.worldSurface, num7 - num16 + 8, generateRoots: false);
		}
		if (generating && SpecialSeedFeatures.DungeonEntranceHasStairs)
		{
			int i2 = i + num4;
			DungeonUtils.GenerateDungeonStairs(data, i2, num7, 1, brickTileType, brickWallType, num5);
			i2 = i - num4;
			DungeonUtils.GenerateDungeonStairs(data, i2, num7, -1, brickTileType, brickWallType, num5);
		}
		Bounds.CalculateHitbox();
	}

	public void TowerEntrance_Door(DungeonData data, int i, int entranceFloor, int outerSize, int innerSize, bool leftDungeonDoor, bool buried)
	{
		int num = (leftDungeonDoor ? (innerSize - 1) : (-outerSize - 2));
		int num2 = (leftDungeonDoor ? (outerSize + 2) : (-innerSize + 1));
		if (buried)
		{
			num += 2 * ((!leftDungeonDoor) ? 1 : 0);
			num2 += 2 * (leftDungeonDoor ? (-1) : 0);
		}
		Point point = new Point(i + (leftDungeonDoor ? (outerSize - 1) : (-outerSize + 1)), entranceFloor);
		Point point2 = new Point(i + (leftDungeonDoor ? (innerSize + 1) : (-innerSize - 1)), entranceFloor);
		for (int j = num; j <= num2; j++)
		{
			for (int k = -3; k <= 1; k++)
			{
				int num3 = j + i;
				int num4 = k + entranceFloor;
				Tile tile = Main.tile[num3, num4];
				if (!buried && ((leftDungeonDoor && num3 >= point.X) || (!leftDungeonDoor && num3 <= point.X)))
				{
					tile.wall = 0;
				}
				if (k >= -2 && k <= 0)
				{
					tile.ClearTile();
				}
			}
		}
		WorldGen.PlaceTile(point.X, point.Y, 10, mute: true, forced: true, -1, 13);
		WorldGen.PlaceTile(point2.X, point2.Y, 10, mute: true, forced: true, -1, 13);
	}

	public void TowerEntrance_LineOfFence(int leftX, int rightX, int y)
	{
		if (y <= 10)
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = leftX; i <= rightX; i++)
		{
			if (leftX >= 10 && rightX <= Main.maxTilesX - 10)
			{
				WorldGen.PlaceWall(i, y, 245, mute: true);
			}
		}
	}

	public void TowerEntrance_OuterPillar(DungeonData data, int pillarX, int pillarY, ushort tileType)
	{
		DungeonPillarSettings dungeonPillarSettings = new DungeonPillarSettings();
		dungeonPillarSettings.Style = settings.StyleData;
		dungeonPillarSettings.PillarType = PillarType.Block;
		dungeonPillarSettings.Width = 7;
		dungeonPillarSettings.Height = 3;
		new DungeonPillar(dungeonPillarSettings).GenerateFeature(data, pillarX, pillarY - 1);
		dungeonPillarSettings.Width = 5;
		dungeonPillarSettings.Height = 7;
		new DungeonPillar(dungeonPillarSettings).GenerateFeature(data, pillarX, pillarY - 4);
		if (pillarY - 11 >= 10)
		{
			WorldGen.PlaceTile(pillarX, pillarY - 11, 215, mute: true);
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
		{
			WorldGen.PlaceWall(pillarX - 2 + i, pillarY - 11, 245, mute: true);
		}
		if (pillarY - 12 >= 10)
		{
			WorldGen.PlaceWall(pillarX - 2, pillarY - 12, 245, mute: true);
			WorldGen.PlaceWall(pillarX + 2, pillarY - 12, 245, mute: true);
		}
		if (pillarY - 10 >= 10)
		{
			WorldGen.PlaceWall(pillarX - 2, pillarY - 10, 245, mute: true);
			WorldGen.PlaceWall(pillarX + 2, pillarY - 10, 245, mute: true);
		}
	}

	public void TowerEntrance_TreeOnPillar(UnifiedRandom genRand, int pillarX, int pillarY)
	{
		int num = 5;
		int num2 = num / 2;
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			int num3 = pillarX + i - num2;
			for (int j = 0; j <= 3; j++)
			{
				int num4 = pillarY + j;
				if (num4 <= 10)
				{
					break;
				}
				if ((j != 1 || genRand.Next(2) != 0) && (j != 2 || genRand.Next(3) == 0) && (j != 3 || genRand.Next(4) == 0))
				{
					Tile tile = Main.tile[num3, num4];
					if (WorldGen.TileIsExposedToAir(num3, num4))
					{
						tile.type = 2;
					}
					else
					{
						tile.type = 0;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (pillarY > 10)
		{
			WorldGen.TryGrowingTreeByType(5, pillarX, pillarY, 0, ignoreWalls: true);
		}
	}

	public void TowerEntrance_AddPlatform(DungeonData data, Point position)
	{
		DungeonPlatformData item = new DungeonPlatformData
		{
			Position = position,
			OverrideHeightFluff = 0,
			ForcePlacement = true,
			PlacePotsChance = 0.33000001311302185,
			PlaceBooksChance = 0.75,
			PlacePotionBottlesChance = 0.10000000149011612,
			NoWaterbolt = true
		};
		data.dungeonPlatformData.Add(item);
	}
}

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.Features;

public class DungeonGlobalBanners : GlobalDungeonFeature
{
	public DungeonGlobalBanners(DungeonFeatureSettings settings)
		: base(settings)
	{
		DungeonCrawler.CurrentDungeonData.dungeonFeatures.Add(this);
	}

	public override bool GenerateFeature(DungeonData data)
	{
		generated = false;
		Banners(data);
		generated = true;
		return true;
	}

	public void Banners(DungeonData data)
	{
		UnifiedRandom genRand = WorldGen.genRand;
		float num = (float)Main.maxTilesX / 4200f;
		double num2 = Math.Max(1.0, data.globalFeatureScalar * 0.75);
		int num3 = (int)((double)(200f * num) * num2);
		for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
		{
			int num4 = genRand.Next(data.dungeonBounds.Left, data.dungeonBounds.Right);
			int num5 = genRand.Next(data.dungeonBounds.Top, data.dungeonBounds.Bottom);
			int num6 = 1000;
			while (!DungeonUtils.IsConsideredDungeonWall(Main.tile[num4, num5].wall) || Main.tile[num4, num5].active())
			{
				num6--;
				if (num6 <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				num4 = genRand.Next(data.dungeonBounds.Left, data.dungeonBounds.Right);
				num5 = genRand.Next(data.dungeonBounds.Top, data.dungeonBounds.Bottom);
			}
			num6 = 1000;
			while (!WorldGen.SolidTile(num4, num5) && num5 > 10)
			{
				num6--;
				if (num6 <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				num5--;
			}
			num5++;
			if (!data.CanGenerateFeatureAt(this, num4, num5) || !DungeonUtils.IsConsideredDungeonWall(Main.tile[num4, num5].wall) || Main.tile[num4, num5 - 1].type == 48 || Main.tile[num4, num5].active() || Main.tile[num4, num5 + 1].active() || Main.tile[num4, num5 + 2].active() || Main.tile[num4, num5 + 3].active())
			{
				continue;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			for (int j = num4 - 1; j <= num4 + 1; j++)
			{
				for (int k = num5; k <= num5 + 3; k++)
				{
					if (Main.tile[j, k].active() && (Main.tile[j, k].type == 10 || Main.tile[j, k].type == 11 || Main.tile[j, k].type == 91))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				continue;
			}
			ushort type = 91;
			int num7 = 0;
			DungeonGenerationStyleData styleForWall = DungeonGenerationStyles.GetStyleForWall(data.genVars.dungeonGenerationStyles, Main.tile[num4, num5].wall);
			if (styleForWall != null && styleForWall.BannerItemTypes == null)
			{
				continue;
			}
			if (styleForWall == null || styleForWall.Style == 0 || styleForWall.BannerItemTypes.Length == 0)
			{
				int num8 = 0;
				if (Main.tile[num4, num5].wall == data.wallVariants[1])

					num8 = 1;

				num7 = placementDetails.tileStyle;

```
#!/bin/zsh
# 收敛矩阵工具（#22）：批量采集原版真值 + oracle 输出 + 头部对拍。
# 用法：
#   zsh tools/convergence-matrix.sh gen <seed...>     # 采集：服务器世界 + oracle 批量（跳过已有）
#   zsh tools/convergence-matrix.sh cmp               # 对拍：输出 (ws,rl,id,moon) 差值表
# 纪律：每条子命令带超时；完成打标记；结束查进程归零。
set -u
GAME=~/Project/GLM/SandboxWorld/game
VSRV=/tmp/vserver
ORACLE_RUNFILE_GLOB="~/Library/Application Support/dotnet/runfile/caves-oracle-*/bin/debug/caves-oracle"
TIMEOUT_WRAP() { local cmd=$1 limit=$2; ( eval "$cmd" & p=$!; sleep "$limit"; kill $p 2>/dev/null ) & wait; }

cmd=${1:-cmp}
mkdir -p "$VSRV"

if [ "$cmd" = gen ]; then
  shift
  for seed in "$@"; do
    # ① 原版服务器世界（≥200s；完成标志=文件存在且 >2.5MB）
    if [ ! -s "$VSRV/s$seed.wld" ] || [ "$(stat -f%z "$VSRV/s$seed.wld" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" -lt 2500000 ]; then
      print "GEN server $seed ..."
      ( cd "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Terraria/Terraria.app/Contents/MacOS" && \
        ./TerrariaServer.bin.osx -world "$VSRV/s$seed.wld" -autocreate 1 -seed "$seed" -port 7797 -players 1 < /dev/null > "$VSRV/log_$seed.txt" 2>&1 & echo $! > "$VSRV/pid_$seed"; sleep 220; kill $(cat "$VSRV/pid_$seed") 2>/dev/null )
    fi
    # ② oracle 全链（金标旁路输出到 /tmp；用 runfile 二进制避免重建）
    if [ ! -s "$VSRV/oracle_$seed.txt" ]; then
      ORACLE=$(ls -td ~/Library/Application\ Support/dotnet/runfile/caves-oracle-* 2>/dev/null | head -1)/bin/debug/caves-oracle
      print "GEN oracle $seed ..."
      ( "$ORACLE" "$seed" 0 "$VSRV/chain_$seed.json" > "$VSRV/oracle_$seed.txt" 2>&1 & p=$!; sleep 400; kill $p 2>/dev/null ) & wait
    fi
  done
  print "GEN-DONE"
fi

if [ "$cmd" = cmp ]; then
  # ③ 对拍（vitest 侧提取 wld 头 + oracle 行）——留给 tools/_matrixcmp.test.ts
  print "对照工具：cd $GAME && npx vitest run tools/_matrixcmp.test.ts"
fi
print "MATRIX-OK"

```

  }

  /** C# NextDouble()（:113-115）*/
  nextDouble(): number {
    return this.sample();
  }

  /** C# Peek()（:88-99，非消耗）：下一 InternalSample 原始差值——对账/断点用 */
  peek(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    return this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
  }
}

// ── RNG：世界生成/运行时统一入口（API 不变，内核换 UnifiedRandom）──────────
// 与原版调用点的对账约定（gen 代码全部按此书写）：
//   rng.next()   = NextDouble()          每次消耗 1 个 InternalSample
//   rng.int(a,b) = Next(a, b+1)          闭区间 [a,b]
//   rng.chance(p)= NextDouble() < p      1 次
//   rng.pick(xs) = xs[Next(xs.length)]   1 次
//   rng.range(a,b) = a + NextDouble()*(b-a)
export class RNG {
  private ur: UnifiedRandom;
  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.ur = new UnifiedRandom(seed);
  }

  next(): number {
    return this.ur.nextDouble();
  }

  /** 闭区间 [min, max]，≡ 原版 Next(min, max+1) */
  int(min: number, max: number): number {
    return this.ur.nextIntRange(min, max + 1);
  }

  range(min: number, max: number): number {

// 确定性随机数：Terraria 1.4.5.6 位级对齐。
//
// ── UnifiedRandom（Terraria.Utilities/UnifiedRandom.cs 1:1）─────────────────
// .NET System.Random 的 Knuth 减法生成器（MSEED=161803398），纯 int32 运算。
// 位级移植要点（JS/C# 数值差异全部钉死，改动前先读）：
//  1. C# int 溢出 unchecked 回绕 ↔ JS：本实现所有中间值都落在 int32 范围内
//     （diff 最小 -(2^31-1)，`+((n>>31)&0x7FFFFFFF)` 归位后 ∈[0,2^31-1]），
//     无需模拟回绕；存储用 Int32Array 与 C# int[] 同构。
//  2. `(int)double` 是向零截断 ↔ JS Math.trunc（Sample()≥0 时与 floor 等价，
//     但必须写 trunc 以防有人把 internalSample 改出负值）。
//  3. `Sample()` 常数 4.656612875245797E-10 = 1/(2^31-1)，十进制字面量两语言
//     解析为同一 double，乘法 IEEE754 位级一致。
//  4. `Next(min,max)` 的 range 用 long（≤2^32）↔ JS number 精确整数，安全。
//     大 range 分支的 `(int)(long+min)` unchecked 回绕 ↔ JS `|0`（ToInt32 mod 2^32）。
//  5. `GetSampleForLargeRange` 的 `% 2 == 0`：C# 余数带符号但只判零，JS `%` 同判。
//  金标：tests/golden/unified-random.json 由真·Terraria.exe 反射导出
//  （tools/golden/rand-golden.cs），tests/unified-random.test.ts 位级断言。
//
// ── 种子解析（WorldFileData.TranslateSeed, cs:399-410 1:1）────────────────
// 数字字符串 → Math.Abs(int)（int.MinValue→int.MaxValue）；非数字 →
// ReLogic.Utilities.Crc32.Calculate（IEEE 表，按 UTF-16 code unit 逐字符，
// 注意 `(crc ^ c) & 0xFF` 只取 char 低字节）。Crc32 结果可为负，直接作种子。
export class UnifiedRandom {
  private seedArray: Int32Array;
  private inext = 0;

  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.seedArray = new Int32Array(56);
    this.setSeed(seed);
  }

  /** C# SetSeed（UnifiedRandom.cs:25-61）1:1 */
  setSeed(seed: number): void {
    this.seedArray.fill(0);
    // C#: (Seed == int.MinValue) ? int.MaxValue : Math.Abs(Seed)
    const num = seed === -2147483648 ? 2147483647 : Math.abs(seed);
    let num2 = 161803398 - num;
    this.seedArray[55] = num2;
    let num3 = 1;
    for (let j = 1; j < 55; j++) {
      const num4 = (21 * j) % 55;
      this.seedArray[num4] = num3;
      num3 = (num2 - num3) | 0; // C# unchecked int：可能回绕，|0 = ToInt32 同语义
      if (num3 < 0) num3 += 2147483647; // C# += int.MaxValue（不是 2^32！）
      num2 = this.seedArray[num4];
    }
    for (let k = 1; k < 5; k++) {
      for (let l = 1; l < 56; l++) {
        this.seedArray[l] -= this.seedArray[1 + ((l + 30) % 55)];
        if (this.seedArray[l] < 0) this.seedArray[l] += 2147483647;
      }
    }
    this.inext = 0;
  }

  /** C# Sample（:63-65）*/
  private sample(): number {
    return this.internalSample() * 4.656612875245797e-10;
  }

  /** C# InternalSample（:67-86）1:1。inext 为 uint 语义（0..55，无溢出面）*/
  private internalSample(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    let num3 = this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
    if (num3 === 2147483647) num3--;
    num3 = num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7fffffff); // >>31 算术移位，JS/C# 一致
    this.seedArray[num] = num3;
    this.inext = num;
    return num3;
  }

  /** C# GetSampleForLargeRange（:96-104）。注意两次 InternalSample 的求值顺序 */
  private getSampleForLargeRange(): number {
    let num = this.internalSample();
    if (this.internalSample() % 2 === 0) num = -num;
    return (num + 2147483646) / 4294967293;
  }

  /** C# Next()（:106-108）：裸 int32 */
  next(): number {
    return this.internalSample();
  }

  /** C# Next(minValue, maxValue)（:115-133）：[min, max)。maxValue 负值时 C# 抛异常，
   *  本移植不抛（生成期契约保证入参合法）。*/
  nextIntRange(minValue: number, maxValue: number): number {
    const num = maxValue - minValue; // C# long 减法，≤2^32，JS 精确
    if (num <= 2147483647) {
      return (Math.trunc(this.sample() * num) + minValue) | 0;
    }
    return (Math.trunc(this.getSampleForLargeRange() * num) + minValue) | 0;
  }

  /** C# Next(maxValue)（:121-127）：[0, max) */
  nextInt(maxValue: number): number {
    return Math.trunc(this.sample() * maxValue);
  }

using var asm = AssemblyDefinition.ReadAssembly(exe, rp);

void Hook(MethodDefinition m, string probeType, string probeMeth, int[] argIdx, bool passThis)
{
    var pr = mod.ImportReference(probeAsm.MainModule.GetType(probeType).Methods.First(x => x.Name == probeMeth));

}

Hook(cga, "Terraria.WorldBuilding.DgFeatProbe", "Mark", new[] { 0, 1, 2 }, false);

// ② DungeonGlobalBookshelves.Bookshelves 入口 → DgGridProbe.Mark（B 起点网格真值）
var dgb = mod.Types.First(t => t.FullName == "Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.Features.DungeonGlobalBookshelves");
var bks = dgb.Methods.First(m => m.Name == "Bookshelves" && m.Parameters.Count == 1);

var udp = du.Methods.First(m => m.Name == "UpdateDungeonProgress" && m.Parameters.Count == 4);

{

using Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.Rooms;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.Features;

public class DungeonGlobalBasicChests : GlobalDungeonFeature
{
	public DungeonGlobalBasicChests(DungeonFeatureSettings settings)
		: base(settings)
	{
		DungeonCrawler.CurrentDungeonData.dungeonFeatures.Add(this);
	}

	public override bool GenerateFeature(DungeonData data)
	{
		generated = false;
		BasicChests(data);
		generated = true;
		return true;
	}

	private void BasicChests(DungeonData data)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < data.dungeonRooms.Count; i++)
		{
			DungeonRoom dungeonRoom = data.dungeonRooms[i];
			for (int j = 0; j < 1000; j++)
			{
				if (dungeonRoom.TryGenerateChestInRoom(data, this))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	{
		UnifiedRandom genRand = WorldGen.genRand;
		int num = (int)Utils.Lerp(minX, maxX, genRand.NextDouble());
		int num2 = (int)Utils.Lerp(minY, maxY, genRand.NextDouble());
		if (!data.CanGenerateFeatureInArea(feature, num, num2, 1))
		{
			return false;
		}
		int itemType = -1;
		ushort chestTileType = 21;
		int chestStyle = 2;
		bool flag = false;
		switch (styleData.Style)
		{
		case 0:
			WorldGen.GetDungeonLootAndChestStyle(num, num2, ref itemType, ref chestStyle);

			break;
		case 8:
		case 9:
		case 14:
			itemType = WorldGen.GetNextJungleChestItem();
			break;
		case 10:
			itemType = 1293;
			break;
		case 13:
			itemType = 832;
			if (genRand.Next(3) == 0)
			{
				itemType = 4281;
			}
			break;
		}
		if (!flag && styleData.ChestItemTypes.Length != 0)
		{
			PlacementDetails placementDetails = ItemID.Sets.DerivedPlacementDetails[styleData.ChestItemTypes[genRand.Next(styleData.ChestItemTypes.Length)]];
			chestTileType = (ushort)placementDetails.tileType;
			chestStyle = placementDetails.tileStyle;
		}
		if (itemType == 0 && genRand.Next(2) == 0)

			return true;

		if (num3 && styleData.Style == 0)
		{
			GenVars.CurrentDungeonGenVars.dungeonLootStyle++;
		}
		return num3;
	}

using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using ReLogic.Utilities;
using Terraria.Utilities;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon;

public class DungeonBounds
{
	[JsonProperty]
	private Rectangle? _hitbox;

	private int _boundsLeft;

	private int _boundsRight;

	private int _boundsTop;

	private int _boundsBottom;

	public Rectangle Hitbox
	{
		get
		{
			if (_hitbox.HasValue)
			{
				return _hitbox.Value;
			}
			return Rectangle.Empty;
		}
	}

	public int X => _boundsLeft;

	public int Y => _boundsTop;

	public int Width => _boundsRight - _boundsLeft;

	public int Height => _boundsBottom - _boundsTop;

	public int Size
	{
		get
		{
			if (Width <= Height)
			{
				return Height;
			}
			return Width;
		}
	}

	public int Left
	{
		get
		{
			return _boundsLeft;
		}
		set
		{
			_boundsLeft = (int)MathHelper.Clamp(value, 10f, Main.maxTilesX - 10);
		}
	}

	public int Right
	{
		get
		{
			return _boundsRight;
		}
		set
		{
			_boundsRight = (int)MathHelper.Clamp(value, 10f, Main.maxTilesX - 10);
		}
	}

	public int Top
	{
		get
		{
			return _boundsTop;
		}
		set
		{
			_boundsTop = (int)MathHelper.Clamp(value, 10f, Main.maxTilesY - 10);
		}
	}

	public int Bottom
	{
		get
		{
			return _boundsBottom;
		}
		set
		{
			_boundsBottom = (int)MathHelper.Clamp(value, 10f, Main.maxTilesY - 10);
		}
	}

	public Point Center => new Point((Left + Right) / 2, (Top + Bottom) / 2);

	public Point RandomPointInBounds(UnifiedRandom genRand)
	{
		return new Point(genRand.Next(Left, Right + 1), genRand.Next(Top, Bottom + 1));
	}

	public void Inflate(int amount)
	{
		SetBounds(Left - amount, Top - amount, Right + amount, Bottom + amount);
	}

	public void Shrink(int amount)
	{
		SetBounds(Left + amount, Top + amount, Right - amount, Bottom - amount);
	}

	public bool ContainsWithFluff(Vector2 point, int fluff)
	{
		if (fluff == 0)
		{
			return Contains((int)point.X, (int)point.Y);
		}
